content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are great for small businesses, but they're not built for creators who want to scale. When you rely on a platform, you're at their mercy. They can freeze your account, charge exorbitant fees, or even shut you down altogether. But with COREMERCH, you own your digital commerce stack. You'll deploy it once, and it will run autonomously, processing payments and delivering products without any intermediaries. This means you'll save time, reduce costs, and increase revenue. You'll also gain full control over your customer data and experience. With our solution, you'll be free to focus on creating more value for your customers, not fighting with a platform to survive.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start selling your digital products with crypto, you'll need to set up a few essential components. First, you'll need a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your store. Next, you'll need a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account for backend logic and automated delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets will handle order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 will manage file delivery. NOWPayments will integrate with your store to process payments and convert cryptocurrencies to USD in real-time. Lastly, you'll need the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy your digital commerce stack in a matter of hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, follow these steps: first, connect your NOWPayments account to your store to start accepting cryptocurrency payments. Next, configure automated delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to deliver your digital products to customers instantly. You'll also need to set up Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to manage file delivery. With this setup, you'll be able to process payments and deliver products to customers without any intermediaries.
You'll save $921 per month on fees by switching to COREMERCH from Gumroad.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can start scaling your business. To do this, you'll need to monitor your performance, adjust your pricing, and optimize your store's user experience. You can also upgrade to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, giving you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.

Your Deployment Checklist

With these steps, you'll be up and running in no time.
